source.title: Some Open Problems in Simple Games

trace.notes: Normalized one URL source, https://zbmath.org/6215962, as a zbMATH resolver record. Direct local shell fetch of zbmath.org failed with a DNS resolution error, and the web reader did not return a readable zbMATH record body.

Local resolver rows identified the exact work as 'Some open problems in simple games' with DOI 10.1142/S0219198913400057. IDEAS/RePEc and the author's publication page confirmed the same title, DOI, authors, journal, volume, and year.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted, with an additional blocked_or_challenged candidate. Bounded exact-work recovery attempted the zbMATH URL, zbMATH API/document endpoint, DOI/publisher URL, Crossref/OpenAlex-style identifier recovery, IDEAS/RePEc, Aisberg, BaDAP AGH, DBLP, the author's publication page, and the exact-title PDF searches. IDEAS reports the publisher full text as restricted to subscribers; Aisberg reports the attached PDF as restricted to repository managers; BaDAP marks open access as no. The author's exact-work Google Drive manuscript link loaded only a preview/sign-in shell through the web reader, and local curl could not resolve drive.google.com because of sandbox DNS restrictions.

No candidate questions were extracted because source adequacy failed: metadata records, abstracts, publication lists, search snippets, and inaccessible preview pages are not acceptable technical evidence under the workflow contract.
Saved failure JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-6215962.json and outputs/latest.json.
